verdict.rationale: Wyoming's own docs advertise online filing ('File Your Wyoming LLC... Online Now!', electronic Annual Report Wizard). The probe shows filings and registered-agent changes sit behind an authenticated account on wyobiz.wyo.gov, which points to a remote credential sign-in. Nothing in the evidence shows biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN, but it also never documents how sign-in works or whether MFA exists. Missing for 10: documented account sign-in and MFA method, confirmation that no in-person, biometric, or mailed-PIN step is required, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
